patch_description: This redesign replaces the object-heavy board and per-candidate history allocation with a flat-state beam-search engine. Boards are stored as compact fixed-size arrays, scoring uses a stack-based fixed-array DSU, and only selected beam states receive persistent trace nodes. Candidate traces are reconstructed directly from their parent when a new global best is found, greatly reducing memory traffic. The selection pipeline uses partial selection before sorting, retaining diversity while avoiding unnecessary full sorts of all generated candidates.
